sections.heading: Nature, scope & relevance of S&T to daily life

blocks.text: **Science** is systematic knowledge of the natural world; **technology** is its application to solve problems. Together they pervade **daily life** — health, communication, transport, agriculture, energy — and drive national development, making S&T literacy essential.

rows: Application of scientific knowledge for practical use.
Health, ICT, agriculture, energy, transport, space, defence, environment.
Mobile/UPI, vaccines, GPS, hybrid seeds, LED, weather forecasts.
A Fundamental Duty (Art. 51A(h)) — rational, questioning outlook.

sections.heading: 🔬 Exam-ready deep coverage: S&T in daily life

items: **S&T in everyday life**: health (vaccines, diagnostics, telemedicine), agriculture (HYV, GM, precision farming), communication (mobile, internet, UPI), transport (GPS, EVs), household (microwave, LED, RO), digital finance (Aadhaar, DBT).
**Recent frontiers**: **AI/ML, 5G, semiconductors, quantum computing, drones, EVs, green hydrogen, gene editing (CRISPR), space-tech**.
**Government thrust**: Digital India, Make in India, Startup India, National missions (Quantum, Semiconductor, Green Hydrogen, Supercomputing-PARAM).
**Why it matters for governance**: evidence-based policy, service delivery (JAM, e-gov), disaster warning, defence self-reliance.

blocks.text: India has evolved a series of **science, technology and innovation policies** — from the **Scientific Policy Resolution (1958)** to the latest **STIP** — to build scientific capacity, promote innovation, and link research to development goals.

rows: Nehru; building a scientific base & temper.

sections.heading: 🔬 Exam-ready deep coverage: S&T and innovation policy

items: **Science policy evolution**: Scientific Policy Resolution 1958 → Technology Policy 1983 → Science & Technology Policy 2003 → **Science, Technology & Innovation Policy (STIP) 2013** → new **STIP (draft 2020)**.
**STIP 2013 goal**: put India among the **top 5 global scientific powers**; raise **GERD (R&D spend)** — India's is ~0.65% of GDP, low vs global.
**Institutions**: **DST, DSIR, DBT, CSIR, PSA (Principal Scientific Adviser)**; **ANRF (Anusandhan National Research Foundation, 2023)** to fund research; Atal Innovation Mission (NITI).
**Indices**: **Global Innovation Index (India ~40th, rising)**; patent & publication growth.

sections.heading: Nature, scope & daily-life use of ICT

blocks.text: **Information and Communication Technology (ICT)** covers the tools that create, store, process and transmit information — **computers, the internet, mobile and networks**. It underpins modern life: communication, banking, education, commerce and governance.

rows: Global network; WWW, email, cloud; protocols (TCP/IP).
UPI/digital payments, e-commerce, online education, telemedicine, social media.
AI, IoT, cloud, big data, 5G, blockchain.

sections.heading: 🔬 Exam-ready deep coverage: ICT — nature & daily use

items: **ICT** = Information & Communication Technology — computing + telecom + internet; hardware, software, networks, data.
**Key concepts**: internet & WWW, cloud computing, IoT (internet of things), big data, AI, 5G, blockchain, cybersecurity.
**Daily use**: e-commerce, digital payments (**UPI — world-leading**), social media, e-learning, telemedicine, GPS navigation, smart devices.
**India Stack**: **Aadhaar (digital identity) + UPI (payments) + DigiLocker + eKYC + eSign + CoWIN** — a public digital infrastructure model studied worldwide.

**Memory units** — bit < byte < KB < MB < GB < TB.

**Digital India** promotes ICT access & digital literacy.

sections.heading: Netiquettes; cyber security; National Cyber Crime Policy

blocks.text: As life goes online, **netiquette (online etiquette), cyber security (protecting systems and data) and cyber-crime law** become vital. India's framework rests on the **IT Act (2000)**, **CERT-In**, and the **National Cyber Security Policy (2013)**.

rows: Courteous, responsible online behaviour; privacy & respect.
**Phishing, malware, ransomware, hacking, identity theft, DDoS**.
India's cyber law; amended 2008; addresses cyber-crime & e-commerce.
Computer Emergency Response Team — India's nodal cyber-incident agency.
**National Cyber Security Policy (2013)**; **I4C** (cyber-crime coordination); cybercrime portal.

sections.heading: 🔬 Exam-ready deep coverage: cyber security & netiquette

items: **Cyber threats**: malware, phishing, ransomware, DDoS, identity theft, data breach, social engineering; **cyber warfare & critical-infrastructure attacks**.

**Legal framework**: **IT Act 2000 (amended 2008)** — cybercrime, digital signatures, Sec 66/67; **CERT-In** (incident response), **NCIIPC** (critical infrastructure), **I4C (Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre)**, **National Cyber Security Policy 2013**, cybercrime portal & helpline **1930**.
**Data protection**: **Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023**; Puttaswamy privacy judgment (2017).
**Netiquette & safety**: strong passwords, 2FA, avoid oversharing, verify links, report cybercrime; digital hygiene.
